basic_profile.bio: I'm a 32-year-old graphic designer based in Portland, Oregon. I have a deep love for creativity and art, which is why I find solace in communities like WitchesVsPatriarchy that offer a mix of empowerment and artistry. Despite my artistic pursuits, I've been battling with alcohol addiction, and I'm trying to find support and encouragement on subreddits like stopdrinking. My work allows me to set flexible hours, so I often find myself online during late evenings. I'm currently single and focusing on personal growth and recovery.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's degree in Fine Arts and have worked in graphic design for over a decade. My knowledge is primarily self-taught with continuous learning through online courses and workshops. I've also developed an interest in vintage arcade games, which led me to subreddits like Arcade1Up.
